TYPE CHECK: The candidate value contains numeric age/time points, which is the correct category for this field.
SOURCE CHECK: The values are present in the text; specifically, the MS analysis was performed on cerebellum isolated from H135Q+/+ and H135Qm/m mice, and the text mentions these mice at ages of 12 weeks, 2-months, and 9 months (and 8-12 weeks for the I/R model).
